About.title: About Us
About.text: Stoffhaus FRU is your new fabric store for high-quality fabrics, sewing supplies, and creative materials in the heart of Wiener Neustadt, Lower Austria (Niederösterreich). We offer a carefully curated collection of fabrics by the metre for every occasion – whether clothing, home textiles, or creative sewing projects. We are happy to provide personal advice and help you find the perfect material and matching sewing supplies for your next project.
